blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه ابوداؤد باب تحزيب القران رقم:١٣٩٤
blocks.tamil_translation: “Whoever completes the recitation of the Qur'an in less than three days will not understand the Qur'an properly.” Hazrat Abdullah ibn Amr (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said this.

blocks.text:
Explanation:- Rasulullah ﷺ said this with the general public in mind; it is stated in some books that some of the Sahabah completed the recitation of the Qur'an in less than three days.
(Sharh at-Tibi)

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ وَاثِلَةَ بْنِ اْلاَسْقَعِ ﵁ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ قَالَ: أُعْطِيتُ مَكَانَ التَّوْرَاةِ السَّبْعَ وَأُعْطِيتُ مَكَانَ الزَّبُورِ الْمِئِينَ وَأُعْطِيتُ مَكَانَ اْلإِنْجِيلِ الْمَثَانِيَ وَفُضِّلْتُ بِالْمُفَصَّلِ.
blocks.tamil_translation: “In place of the Tawrat, I have been given the first seven chapters (surahs) of the Holy Qur'an; in place of the Zabur, the “Mi'in” (the eleven surahs that follow); in place of the Injil, the “Mathani “(the twenty surahs that follow them). After that, the Mufassal surahs up to the end of the Qur'an have been given specially to me.” Hazrat Wathilah ibn Asqa' (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said this.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ رَحِمَهُ اللهُ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِﷺ فِي فَاتِحَةِ الْكِتَابِ شِفَاءٌ مِّنْ كُلِّ دَاءٍ.
blocks.tamil_translation: “In “Surah al-Fatihah” there is a cure for every disease,” Hazrat Abdul Malik ibn Umair (RH) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said this.
